decks.notes: This deck focuses on using Greasefang, Okiba Boss as a key combo piece to generate card advantage and create a strong board presence. By utilizing cards like Grisly Salvage, Esika's Chariot, and Raffine's Informant, the deck aims to efficiently fill the graveyard with creature cards to power up Greasefang's abilities. The inclusion of other powerful cards like Parhelion II and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship provide additional threats and support to overwhelm opponents. The deck also features disruption and removal spells like Duress, Thoughtseize, and Witherbloom Command to control the game and protect the combo pieces.

The main concept of this deck revolves around utilizing creatures with flash and tempo plays to control the board while attacking aggressively. By using cards like Rattlechains, Mausoleum Wanderer, and Spell Queller to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while buffing the team with cards like Supreme Phantom and Shacklegeist, this deck aims to apply consistent pressure and close out games quickly. The inclusion of Curious Obsession provides card advantage and helps maintain momentum. The deck also features some utility lands and versatile spells to provide additional flexibility in various game situations.

The deck focuses on assembling the Lotus Field combo quickly by using cards like Arboreal Grazer, Vizier of Tumbling Sands, and Sylvan Scrying to find and untap Lotus Field. Hidden Strings and Pore Over the Pages provide card draw and dig for necessary combo pieces. Emergent Ultimatum and Dark Petition offer additional ways to tutor for win conditions like Omniscience. The deck aims to generate a large amount of mana and cast powerful spells like Dig Through Time and Lier, Disciple of the Drowned to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using green devotion creatures and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, then use that mana to play powerful threats like Cavalier of Thorns, Karn, the Great Creator, and Old-Growth Troll. Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner helps to draw cards and untap mana dorks, while Storm the Festival allows for tutoring for more threats. The deck also has some toolbox options like Blast Zone and Boseiju, Who Endures, with a potential win condition in Cityscape Leveler and Wrenn and Realmbreaker.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Neoform combo to quickly and efficiently bring out Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield. It includes cards like Tasigur, the Golden Fang and Hooting Mandrills for additional control and threats, while also running a package of interactive spells like Thoughtseize and Stubborn Denial. Strategic Planning and Consider help with card selection and digging for combo pieces, with Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion for additional mana acceleration. The deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm opponents with powerful threats.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly with mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, as well as Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, to cast powerful green creatures and planeswalkers like Cavalier of Thorns, Karn, the Great Creator, and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner. The deck also utilizes cards like Storm the Festival and Oath of Nissa to help find key pieces in the deck, while also including a few utility lands like Lair of the Hydra and Boseiju, Who Endures. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with big threats and aggressive plays.

This deck focuses on utilizing cheap, evasive creatures with disruptive abilities to establish early control of the board and pressure the opponent quickly. By playing aggressive creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer and Spectral Sailor alongside powerful enchantments like Curious Obsession, the deck aims to chip away at the opponent's life total while keeping their threats in check with cards like Spell Queller and Shacklegeist. The deck also includes counter spells and removal to protect its board presence and maintain tempo. Katilda, Dawnhart Martyr, Geistlight Snare, and Otawara, Soaring City provide additional synergy and utility to the deck's overall game plan.

This deck revolves around the powerful synergy between Lotus Field and various untap effects like Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to generate massive amounts of mana quickly. With cards like Pore Over the Pages and Thespian's Stage to dig through the deck for combo pieces, the goal is to cast big spells like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience to win the game in a single explosive turn. The deck also includes other toolbox cards like Dark Petition and Mastermind's Acquisition to search for specific answers or win conditions as needed.

This aggressive Rakdos deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize while controlling the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. It also leverages powerful threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to apply pressure and close out games quickly. The deck aims to curve out efficiently while punishing the opponent's life total, utilizing a combination of versatile creatures and disruptive cards to stay ahead in the game and secure victories.

This Pioneer 1 vs 1 Goblins deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays, utilizing cards like Skirk Prospector and Wily Goblin to ramp up mana and pump out creatures. With cards like Conspicuous Snoop and Battle Cry Goblin, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a horde of Goblin creatures. Rally the Ancestors can bring back key Goblins from the graveyard for a final push, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Rundvelt Hordemaster provide additional support and utility for the deck's strategy.

The main focus of this Dimir control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain control over the board through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. The deck utilizes cards like Thoughtseize, Negate, and Sinister Sabotage to counter spells and disrupt the opponent's strategy. In addition, the deck includes powerful removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act to deal with threats on the board. Card advantage is gained through cards like Dig Through Time, Narset, Parter of Veils, and Memory Deluge, allowing the player to draw into more answers and threats.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to establish a fast and aggressive playstyle. The deck focuses on utilizing low-cost creatures such as Favored Hoplite and Monastery Swiftspear to deal damage quickly. To protect and enhance these creatures, spells like Gods Willing and Boros Charm are used to provide protection and additional damage. Reckless Rage and Dreadhorde Arcanist offer removal options to clear the opponent's board. Feather, the Redeemed acts as a key card, allowing the player to continually recur spells and maintain a strong board presence. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and well-timed spells.

The deck focuses on playing low-cost spirits and leveraging their abilities to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan while also maintaining tempo with counterspells and removal. The synergy between creatures like Rattlechains and Mausoleum Wanderer, combined with powerful cards like Spell Queller and Skyclave Apparition, allows the deck to apply pressure while keeping the opponent on the back foot. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, ultimately winning through a combination of efficient threats and disruption.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive Azorius spirits with a tempo strategy. By utilizing cheap creatures with disruptive abilities like Spell Queller and Rattlechains, the deck aims to control the game while maintaining pressure on the opponent. Cards like Curious Obsession and Spectral Sailor provide card advantage and additional threats. Lofty Denial helps to counter key spells, while Shacklegeist can tap down blockers. The deck also includes some utility lands like Mutavault and Hengegate Pathway for added flexibility. Finally, Otawara, Soaring City and Invasion of Gobakhan offer powerful late-game options to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently cycle through the deck to fill the graveyard with spells, enabling the quick resurrection of Arclight Phoenix. The deck includes various card draw and selection spells, along with cheap removal and counterspells to control the board and protect the phoenixes. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of phoenixes and burn spells, dealing large amounts of damage in a short amount of time.

This deck focuses on using Metamorphic Alteration and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to transform Archfiend of the Dross into powerful threats, while using control and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes card draw and selection tools such as Consider and Dig Through Time to find the necessary combo pieces. The goal is to create a dominating board presence with altered Archfiends and outvalue the opponent with card advantage.
